# Zoho Sign

Zoho Sign provides electronic signature workflows for creating, sending, tracking, and managing documents, templates, recipients, and account resources.

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/zoho-sign/.

## Actions

- **Create Folder**: Create a persistent Zoho Sign folder.
- **Create Request**: Upload 1-40 PDF documents and create a Zoho Sign draft request.
- **Create Request From Merged Templates**: Create one Zoho Sign request from two or more compatible templates.
- **Create Request From Template**: Create a Zoho Sign request from a template.
- **Create Request Type**: Create a persistent Zoho Sign document/request type.
- **Create Signer Group**: Create a persistent Zoho Sign signer group with named email recipients.
- **Create Template**: Upload 1-40 PDF documents and create a reusable Zoho Sign template with recipient roles and signer fields.
- **Delete Document**: Permanently delete one document file from an owned Zoho Sign request.
- **Delete Request**: Destructively move an owned Zoho Sign request to trash.
- **Delete Template**: Destructively move an owned reusable Zoho Sign template to trash.
- **Download Completion Certificate** (read-only): Download the PDF completion certificate for a fully signed request.
- **Download Document** (read-only): Download one PDF document from a Zoho Sign request.
- **Download Request** (read-only): Download all documents in a Zoho Sign request as a PDF or ZIP, optionally merged and including the completion certificate.
- **Email Completed Request**: Immediately email an owned completed Zoho Sign request to one to three addresses.
- **Extend Request**: Extend the signing-link expiration date of an owned sent request.
- **Generate Embedded Signing URL**: Generate a one-time URL for a human to sign one recipient action from a previously submitted request.
- **Generate Request Embedded Send URL**: Generate a short-lived, human-facing embedded editor URL for an owned active draft request.
- **Generate Template Embedded Send URL**: Generate a short-lived embedded editor and sending URL for an owned Zoho Sign template.
- **Get Organization** (read-only): Get the connected Zoho Sign organization, license label, administrative context, and relevant template, embedded-workflow, and…
- **Get Request** (read-only): Get one request's status, documents, recipient actions, and signer fields.
- **Get Request Field Data** (read-only): Get recipient-entered field labels and values from a completed Zoho Sign request.
- **Get Request Reminder Settings** (read-only): Get automatic email reminder settings for an owned Zoho Sign request.
- **Get Template** (read-only): Get one Zoho Sign template's documents, reusable recipient roles, signer fields, and prefill fields.
- **List Field Types** (read-only): List account-specific Zoho Sign field type IDs, names, categories, and mandatory defaults for use when placing signer fields.
- **List Folders** (read-only): Return one controllable page of Zoho Sign folders.
- **List My Requests** (read-only): Return one controllable page of requests assigned to or pending for the connected Zoho Sign user.
- **List Request Types** (read-only): Return one controllable page of Zoho Sign document request types.
- **List Requests** (read-only): Return one controllable page of Zoho Sign document requests, optionally filtered by status and search columns.
- **List Signer Group Recipients** (read-only): Return one page of recipients for a Zoho Sign signer group.
- **List Signer Groups** (read-only): Return one controllable page of Zoho Sign signer groups, optionally filtered by group name.
- **List Templates** (read-only): Return one controllable page of reusable Zoho Sign templates.
- **List Users** (read-only): Return one controllable page of users in the connected Zoho Sign organization without email addresses or profile photos.
- **Mark Request For Correction**: Move an owned in-progress request into correction mode before any signer completes.
- **Merge Templates Into Request**: Merge at least two owned templates into an existing owned Zoho Sign draft request.
- **Preview Template Merge** (read-only): Preview whether two or more Zoho Sign templates are compatible for merging and retrieve the merged fields and recipient roles.
- **Recall Request**: Irreversibly recall an owned sent Zoho Sign request and cancel its remaining signing process.
- **Remind Request Recipients**: Immediately send a real reminder email to every pending recipient of an owned sent request.
- **Self Sign Request**: Irreversibly apply the connected user's legal signature and complete an owned Zoho Sign self-sign request.
- **Submit Request**: Irreversibly send an owned Zoho Sign draft request to its recipients after applying final signer fields.
- **Update Request**: Update an owned draft or correction-mode request, including settings, recipients, fields, and optional added files.
- **Update Request Type**: Rename or change the description of an existing Zoho Sign document request type.
- **Update Signer Group**: Rename an owned Zoho Sign signer group, add recipients, and remove existing recipients by ID.
- **Update Template**: Update an owned Zoho Sign template's settings, reusable roles, signer fields, field removals, and optional added PDF documents.
